secConfig = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.security.getConfig({}), 'configName', 'configValue')
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(value['user'])	
	userCRUD = system.kanoa.security.getUserAssetCRUD(userId)
	
	return {"userId": userId, "config": secConfig, "userCRUD": userCRUD}

if value['filter']['assetId'] is None: return []
	
	data = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(value['scheduledEvents'])
	deleteRows = [i for i, row in enumerate(data) if row['assetId'] != value['filter']['assetId']]
	data = system.dataset.deleteRows(data, deleteRows)
	if 'en' not in value['locale']: data = system.kanoa.utilities.translateData(data, ['itemName', 'modeName', 'units', 'workOrderStatus'], value['locale'])
	data = system.dataset.sort(data, 'startDate', False)	
	data = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(data)
	for row in data:
		if row['workOrderId']:
			woInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'workOrderId': row['workOrderId']}),0)
#			return woInfo
			row['actualQty'] = woInfo['actualQty']
			row['reqdQty'] = woInfo['reqdQty']
			row['% Complete'] = woInfo['reqdQty'] or 0 / woInfo['actualQty'] if (woInfo['actualQty'] or 0) > 0 else None
			row['itemUnitName'] = woInfo['itemUnitName']
			row['itemColor'] = woInfo['itemColor'] or woInfo['itemClassColor']
			row['workOrderSourceImagePath'] = woInfo['workOrderSourceImagePath'] if row['modeName'] == 'Production' else 'No image'
			row['itemUnitName'] = woInfo['itemUnitName']
			row['dueDate'] = woInfo['dueDate']
			row['workOrderStatusName'] = woInfo['workOrderStatusName']
			row['statusColor'] = woInfo['statusColor']
			row['note'] = woInfo['note']
			
		else:
			row['reqdQty'] = None
			row['actualQty'] = None
			row['% Complete'] = None
			row['itemUnitName'] = None
			row['workOrderSourceImagePath'] = None
			row['itemUnitName'] = None
			row['itemColor'] = None
			row['dueDate'] = None
			row['workOrderStatusName'] = None
			row['statusColor'] = None
			row['note'] = None
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("showInfoToast", {'message': '%s production orders found'%len(data)})		
	return data
